title: Streak
description: data of: streak.py [FRAME] --json. The straight streaks in one frame and, for each, the satellites that passed near it with how well each fits. A satellite is named only when it alone fits.

timed_by.description: Where the start came from: the frame's own time, or when it arrived less its exposure.

orbits.description: The orbits used; null when there was no streak to check.

ends.description: Its two ends in pixels of the brightness image (half the raw frame's size).

at_edge.description: Whether each end is at the frame's border, where the streak may go on beyond it.

ends_sky.description: Each end's RA and Dec, degrees, J2000.

profile.description: Its brightness in eighths along it, as a share of the mean: even for a satellite.

named.description: The one satellite that fits, or null when none or more than one does.

offset_deg.description: How far its path passes from the streak's further end.

angle_deg.description: The angle between its path and the streak.

at.description: When it was nearest the streak's middle, UTC.

ends_at_s.description: When it was at each end of the streak, seconds after the shutter opened.

sunlit_length_deg.description: How far it went in sunlight while the shutter was open.
